design.title: swarmy
design.description: Agent swarm infrastructure: session scheduling, step execution, and inference.

containers.label: Control plane
containers.description: Scheduler, step workers, and inference gateway services.

containers.label: State
containers.description: Durable session state, message streams, and large objects.

nodes.label: swarmy CLI
nodes.description: Creates sessions, wakes them, and streams live events.

nodes.label: FoundationDB
nodes.description: Stores sessions, event logs, leases, the runnable index, and idempotency records.

nodes.label: Inference gateway
nodes.description: Consumes inference jobs from NATS, calls the model provider, and writes completions to FoundationDB.

nodes.label: NATS JetStream
nodes.description: Carries work queues and live event feeds.

nodes.label: Object storage
nodes.description: S3-compatible storage for large payloads and snapshots.

nodes.label: ChatGPT
nodes.description: External model provider called by the inference gateway.

nodes.label: Scheduler
nodes.description: Scans FoundationDB for runnable sessions, publishes nudges on NATS, reaps expired leases, and answers wake requests.

nodes.label: Step workers
nodes.description: Claim session leases, run the harness, execute local tools, and publish inference jobs. One node represents the worker pool.

notes.text: Sessions, event logs, leases, runnable index, idempotency records.
Harness and local tools run in each worker.
Work queues and live event feeds share the bus.
